# Every luvdis block in the ROM, by address: the 743 luvdis found, the 409
# pointer-only or uncalled Thumb functions seed_functions.py added, and the 7
# hand-written ARM blocks. progress.py counts one function per block, so the
# list stays fixed while functions are renamed, merged into multi-function C
# files, or moved into folders. A C function that isn't a block start (the
# out-of-line copy of an inline helper) belongs to the block before it.
